sources.title: Creating a Book — Quarto
sources.version_or_commit: Current official documentation; no release pin displayed
sources.locator: Overview; Config File; Workflow; HTML books/search; output formats HTML/PDF/Word/EPUB
sources.operation: Opened official Quarto book guide; read overview/config/workflow.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Quarto book chapters can render to several formats; HTML books are special websites and support full-text search. Rendering is a build action, not evidence of identical interactive behavior.
sources.applicability: Supports comparing one multi-output authoring source; does not establish offline caching or export fidelity.

sources.title: Website Search — Quarto
sources.version_or_commit: Current official documentation; no release pin displayed
sources.locator: Overview; local index default; hosted Algolia option; per-document search:false
sources.operation: Opened official search docs; read index/config behavior.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Website/book search is enabled by default and builds a local index unless configured to hosted Algolia; per-page search can be excluded.
sources.applicability: Local index may support privacy/offline design, but initial-load/offline operation still depends on local assets/cache and must be tested.

sources.title: Deploying Your Docs — MkDocs
sources.version_or_commit: Current official docs; release context separately checked at tag 1.6.1
sources.locator: Offline viewing; file:// search caveat; bundled theme support files; site_dir
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: For file:// viewing, disable built-in search or use a file-scheme-compatible plugin; offline themes must not rely on CDNs.
sources.applicability: Distinguishes a static output directory from a functional offline searchable app.

sources.title: Pandoc User’s Guide
sources.version_or_commit: Current public manual; manual page does not display release pin
sources.locator: Conversion model/loss; DOCX reader styles; docx+styles extension
sources.operation: Read primary manual sections on conversion and Word style handling.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Pandoc's intermediate representation is less expressive than many sources, so conversions from more expressive sources can be lossy; default DOCX reader maps known styles, while +styles adds custom-style attributes.
sources.applicability: Supports constrained import/review instead of assumed Word fidelity; pair with pinned reader tests.

sources.title: PDF Basics — Quarto
sources.version_or_commit: Current official documentation; no release pin displayed
sources.locator: PDF Accessibility & Standards; PDF/UA-2, fig-alt and veraPDF; retrieved lines 552-612
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Quarto can request tagged PDF/UA and pass fig-alt to PDF; docs explicitly say Quarto cannot guarantee accessibility and recommend validation/manual attention.
sources.applicability: Handout export needs its own rendered-PDF validation; HTML checks do not prove PDF quality.

sources.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 — W3C
sources.locator: SC 1.1.1 Non-text Content; SC 2.1.1 Keyboard; focus order criteria
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Non-text content needs text alternatives serving equivalent purpose except listed cases; functionality must be keyboard operable under SC 2.1.1.
sources.applicability: Normative target for UI/content; not a certification claim.

sources.title: Images Tutorial — WAI/W3C
sources.version_or_commit: Current W3C WAI tutorial; no release pin displayed
sources.locator: Informative/decorative images; images of text; complex images
sources.operation: Read official authoring tutorial for text alternatives.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Complex diagrams/graphs need a complete text equivalent; image alternatives are context-sensitive; readable text should not be embedded in images.
sources.applicability: Applies to repair diagrams and step instructions.

sources.title: Developing a Keyboard Interface — WAI-ARIA APG
sources.version_or_commit: Current W3C APG guidance; informative, not WCAG normative text
sources.locator: Discernible and Predictable Keyboard Focus; DOM order and reading order
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: DOM order normally determines tab and screen-reader reading order; APG recommends aligning them and avoiding positive tabindex.
sources.applicability: Implementation guidance; WCAG remains the normative acceptance basis.

sources.title: Using Service Workers — MDN Web Docs
sources.version_or_commit: Current MDN guide; no release pin displayed
sources.locator: Secure context lines 188-197; update behavior 217-236; install cache 297-328
sources.operation: Read secure-context, install/cache and update sections.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Service workers require HTTPS (localhost exception for development); installation caches selected assets; a new worker waits for old controlled pages to close unless skipWaiting is used.
sources.applicability: Hosted PWA needs explicit install, cache completeness, update migration and stale-client tests.

sources.title: Using IndexedDB — MDN Web Docs
sources.version_or_commit: Current MDN guide; no release pin displayed
sources.locator: Overview/basic pattern; async API and offline structured queries
sources.operation: Read official guide result and overview.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: IndexedDB is browser-local structured data with an async API and supports offline queries; storage is origin scoped.
sources.applicability: Candidate for local progress; does not provide server sync or cross-device transfer.

sources.title: Storage Quotas and Eviction Criteria — MDN Web Docs
sources.version_or_commit: Current MDN guide; no release pin displayed
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Storage is best-effort by default and may be deleted under storage pressure, inactivity in some browsers, private-session end or user clearing; persist() approval varies.
sources.applicability: No promise of permanent progress; describe local scope and loss/reset limits.

sources.title: Quarto issue #14756 — dashboard search index omitted
sources.version_or_commit: Opened 2026-08-08; issue observed open at retrieval; dashboard pages
sources.locator: Issue reproduction, actual behavior and expected behavior
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Reporter says search.json omitted for all-dashboard sites and dashboard pages omitted from mixed site index; report does not establish a fix.
sources.applicability: Do not assume Quarto dashboard pages are searchable without release-specific test; not evidence of a problem in ordinary HTML lesson pages.

sources.title: Pandoc 3.12.1 DOCX reader implementation
sources.locator: runStyleToTransform / Ext_styles branch, source around line 2541
sources.operation: Inspected repository source at pinned release tag.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Code checks Ext_styles before preserving custom style spans; behavior is conditional on reader option.
sources.applicability: Corroborates manual's default-versus-opt-in DOCX style mapping.

sources.title: Pandoc 3.12.1 DOCX reader tests
sources.locator: testGroup custom styles: default versus +styles; fixture/golden files
sources.operation: Inspected pinned tests; did not run them.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Tests compare default parse and Ext_styles output against separate golden files.
sources.applicability: Shows focused regression coverage, not arbitrary-format fidelity.

sources.title: Pandoc 3.12.1 release notes
sources.locator: Notable changes; data URI regression fix #11942 and DOCX reader performance improvements
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Release records serious regression fix affecting --embed-resources and performance improvements including DOCX reader.
sources.applicability: Pin build tools and exercise import/embed regression fixtures on upgrades.

sources.title: Pandoc 3.12.1 DOCX reader registry/caller
sources.locator: Exported readDocx, readers registry maps docx to ByteStringReader readDocx; getReader dispatches via the format name, around lines 650-985
sources.operation: Inspected pinned caller/registry source at release tag.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: DOCX enters the reader registry as a binary reader; getReader finds it by format name and applies format extension options.
sources.applicability: Confirms importer path and its option-controlled behaviors are part of a real caller pipeline; does not validate a handbook import UX.

sources.title: IndexedDB key characteristics and basic terminology — MDN
sources.version_or_commit: Current MDN guide; last modified 2026-09-04, no API release pin
sources.locator: Key characteristics and limitations, lines 187-219 in retrieved page
sources.operation: Opened official guide; inspected same-origin, offline, synchronization and full-text-search limits.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: IndexedDB is per-origin object storage, supports offline queries, is not designed to synchronize with a server or provide full-text search, and browser databases may be wiped in listed conditions.
sources.applicability: Keep bundled lesson/search index separate from local learner progress; maintain a stable origin and explain that no sync/cross-device transfer exists.

sources.title: MkDocs 1.6.1 search-index implementation
sources.operation: Inspected release-tag source implementation; did not execute it.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The indexer creates a page entry and heading-section entries and serializes docs/config to JSON; full page text depends on configured indexing mode.
sources.applicability: Supports the client-side index comparison; no claim that file:// works, which MkDocs offline docs specifically qualify.
